0022600005.text: Both the Golden State Warriors and the Los Angeles Lakers open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the Warriors on the road, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Golden State a 35% chance to win. The Warriors are missing Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, who are out following knee surgery, and Kristaps Porzingis, who is out for undisclosed reasons, while Brandin Podziemski (back), Charles Bassey (knee) and Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Lakers have Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton and Jarred Vanderbilt listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Golden State lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 119-103 defeat in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
